description: This file defines the Session class within the Opencart admin startup controller namespace. It manages the creation and configuration of user sessions, including starting sessions with specific options such as security settings and session lifetime.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing user session initialization and security configuration in the admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the session object, retrieves session ID from cookies, starts the session, and sets appropriate cookie options to ensure session security.
